response.original_title: SCALP - Si Calmes Accourent Les Picaros
response.overview: This film chronicles the adventures of an honorable man—fearless and beyond reproach—wandering through the Pyrenees, accompanied by his loyal squire, Agathe: simple-minded, yet noble of heart. It tells the story of Hadrien, a 37-year-old eccentric who lives in a castle and finds himself lost high in the mountains with a six-year-old girl, her unicorn pajamas, and her father’s ashes.
response.title: SCALP - Si Calmes Accourent Les Picaros
